response.sql: WITH member_major AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.link_to_major, maj.major_id, maj.department FROM member m INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id), total_members AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM member_major), major_counts AS (SELECT major_id, department, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member_major GROUP BY major_id, department), major_with_share AS (SELECT mc.major_id, mc.department, mc.member_count, CAST(mc.member_count AS FLOAT) / tm.total_count as share FROM major_counts mc CROSS JOIN total_members tm), department_avg_share AS (SELECT department, AVG(share) as avg_share FROM major_with_share GROUP BY department), major_above_avg AS (SELECT mws.major_id, mws.department, mws.member_count, mws.share, mws.share - das.avg_share as difference_above_avg FROM major_with_share mws INNER JOIN department_avg_share das ON mws.department = das.department WHERE mws.share > das.avg_share) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, difference_above_avg FROM major_above_avg ORDER BY difference_above_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
